purpose: DOCUMENTARY_ONLY: resolve the actual eleven schema headers, hierarchy, field definitions, units, uncertainty/covariance and provenance roles in the pinned public technical documentation. No empirical benchmark admission or modeling.
authorization: Root task explicitly authorizes one ordinary request and full documentary reading including potentially empirical examples/comments under Alex renewed evidence-acquisition authorization. Earlier PARTIAL role-only parser proposal remains unchanged, deferred and unimplemented; this separate scope does not revise an implemented reader, frozen benchmark or scientific protocol.
license: Record declares CC BY4.0. Embedded body notices remain uninspected; no general archive/software/cited-work license transfer.

exposure.machine: Whole raw documentation body, decoded text and all schema cells may be read, including examples/options/comments/defaults that may contain empirical values. Acquisition/decoding/parsing stages and failures will be recorded.
exposure.researcher: Explicitly permits inspecting the complete documentation, including potential empirical example values and comments, to understand schema semantics. Exposure will be reported honestly; this is not target-blind or untouched evidence.
exposure.publication: Own paraphrase and necessary selected field labels/definitions with row/column citations and source hash; no full raw CSV, arbitrary example values, low-entropy cell hashes or copied long comments. Numerical conventions such as unit symbols or proof-strain definitions may be described as technical definitions, not observations.

inspection: After size/MD5 match, inspect documented byte/BOM/response charset and actual text layout. Record exact strict decode and delimiter choices plus ambiguity/failure. This is documentary investigation, not an execution of the earlier closed PARTIAL parser. Do not claim its predicates passed. No formula/expression evaluation, link following, secondary-file opening or data fitting.
stop_rules: HTTP/access/redirect/transport failure ends this route with retained receipt; no retry or alternative URL.
Size, advertised MD5 or unsupported content encoding mismatch stops content interpretation.
Unknown encoding or layout is reported rather than silently repaired.
Any need for measurement workbook/LIS/XLSX/images or linked standards/fulltexts is outside this scope.
independent_review: Separate agent may read only the same retained pinned documentation and public metadata/projections locally, under the same full-documentary exposure; no additional request.
